t: Seattle is Dying | A KOMO News Documentary

q.x: There is a really great documentary on dealing with drug issues in Seattle. It's called "Seattle is Dying" and it's on YouTube: [link]

desc:
KOMO Anchor Eric Johnson takes an in-depth look at the impact the drug and homelessness problem is having on our city and possible solutions in "Seattle is Dying," a news documentary that aired on KOMO-TV in March, 2019. You can read the full story and watch at KOMONews.com: https://komonews.com/news/local/komo-news-special-seattle-is-dying.
